description: This file defines build configurations, device configurations, and related scripts for specific hardware devices (such as ASUS OnHub and TP-Link OnHub) within the OpenWrt project. It includes device-specific parameters, build steps, and code for handling images and firmware.

methods.name: Device/dsa-migration
methods.description: Defines a device compatibility check and message related to migrating from swconfig to DSA.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build step that copies and prepares the GPT partition table.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel image to the firmware image.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Signs the firmware image with verified boot (vboot) using cros-vbutil.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines parameters and image composition for OnHub devices.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for ASUS OnHub, combining the image and migration definitions plus device-specific parameters.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for TP-Link OnHub, similar to the ASUS device setup.
